sources.quote: Torino Plant 3 (TO3) is not in scope of this record.
APPROVAL AP-0208: part BR-180; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6061-T6; status APPROVED 2024-10-14 (PPAP-2024-091)
Approval is granted per part, per receiving plant and per customer, never per supplier.

findings.why: The proposal is BR-180 at Plant 3 (TO3) for STL with billet from Alluminio B Settimo. Alluminio B's approval for BR-180 and STL covers TO1 only, and approvals are per receiving plant. The approved supplier list does not cover TO3, so no controlled record covers this part, plant and customer. The absence of an approval cannot be read as 'not approved'. A person must confirm whether a TO3 approval exists elsewhere or has to be obtained before the pilot builds.
